subject: data_science
prompt_suffix: Render this as a clean educational diagram. IMPORTANT layout constraints: - Keep the entire diagram fully contained inside the canvas. - Center the diagram and scale it down if needed. - Leave at least 15% safe margin on the left, right, top, and bottom. - No text, arrow, line, box, icon, node, label, or table cell may touch or cross the image boundaries. - Prefer a balanced landscape composition for wide diagrams. - Use a clean white background and readable Open Sans, Clear Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, Segoe UI Emoji, SF Pro, sans-serif typography.

images.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four scatter plots, each showing a different distribution of points but having nearly identical descriptive statistics (mean, variance, correlation coefficient). Each plot should be clearly labeled as Dataset I, II, III, IV. The pedagogical intent is to visually demonstrate why data visualization is crucial even when summary statistics are similar, highlighting different patterns and outliers.

images.prompt: A histogram showing the distribution of 'Customer Age'. The x-axis is 'Age' with bins (e.g., 20-30, 30-40, etc.), and the y-axis is 'Frequency' or 'Count'. The bars should show a somewhat normal or slightly skewed distribution. The pedagogical intent is to illustrate how a histogram reveals the shape and spread of a single numerical variable.
